scope: Two existing training initial-state groups with their frozen reverse histories. Generate deterministic data for timing coverage at tick 168. This plan defines the future capture. The current round only performs static preflight.
branches: Reuse directions and branch order from the pinned reference design. Add the signed offsets to each training history's own nominal requests. Keep all H32 steps, including the offset-zero tail and the nominal release at absolute tick 184.
prefix: For each case, start from its original initial conditions and replay absolute ticks 0 through 167 exactly once under the deterministic backend. Keep the solver running through the prefix; capture a native snapshot at control tick 168, then restore independently for all eight branches. Check both state buffers, snapshot layout, controls and clock. Older default-solver ball trajectories are provenance only.

gates.nominal: Both H32 same-case nominal branches must finish and pass exact controls, timing and retention checks, tool-frame max component differences <=1e-5 m, <=1e-3 m/s, <=2e-2 rad/s, and position half spread <=1e-6 m at H8/H16/H24/H32 before any perturbation.
gates.shared_prefix: Per sign, pitch pulse and pitch reversal share the first eight transitions. Require identical actions, executed commands, clock and retention categories through H8, the nominal numerical ceilings and position half-distance <=1e-6 m at each shared lead. Record candidate counts and shape pairs.
gates.signal: Record sign-pair half differences for every lead. Report SI vector-family floors 1e-6 m, 1e-5 m/s, 1e-4 rad/s, raised to 5x nominal noise or float roundoff where needed; 10x is strong. Weak signals stay in the capture with eligibility annotations. These are capture and resolution checks only.

data_contract.eligibility: Publish a training manifest only after both cases finish all branches and all consistency and nominal gates pass. Keep partial artifacts with stopped status outside the training manifest.
data_contract.nominal: Two named zero-offset branches per snapshot. Store requested Hx2 sequences and trace hashes for both.
data_contract.split_rule: All branches and future amplitudes of a physical initial group use the existing group split. Keep negative_y_basin as development validation. Preserve relative training group mass in any later coverage-only ablation and measure state and paired response separately.

stop_conditions: Frozen inputs, source identity, controller preflight or scene layout fail
Prefix or branch incomplete, terminated or invalid; timing, exact tracked control, restore check, nominal gate or shared prefix gate fails
Any resource or physics step cap, or both cases complete
No automatic retry, replacement case, increased amplitude, or expansion beyond the fixed branch list
